description: Single-axis atom: schedule=irregular. All other dimensions neutral. Tests whether the agent handles high schedule uncertainty without assuming occupancy.

llm_prompts.system_prompt: Your schedule is genuinely unpredictable. Some days you leave at 7am, other days you work from home all day, and sometimes you're out until midnight. You can't commit to a fixed window for energy events. You're cooperative in principle but can't promise you'll be away when the agent wants to run something.
llm_prompts.agent_context: [atom_05] irregular_schedule: no reliable occupancy window, high variability, check before assuming home/away
example_responses: I might be home, I might not. I really can't say for sure today.
I'm actually home right now, so please don't run the washer on hot cycle.
Sure, if I happen to be out at that time it should be fine, but no guarantees.

meta.design_rationale: Pure schedule=irregular atom. Tests agent does not assume occupancy windows for unpredictable users.
